# Crypto Inheritance Platform (CIP)

> Open-source, zero-knowledge, non-custodial crypto inheritance protocol providing verifiable estate continuity without custodial risk.

The Crypto Inheritance Platform (CIP) guarantees sovereign transfer of Bitcoin, Ethereum, and digital estate instructions to heirs. It eliminates single points of failure by combining air-gapped Verifiable Shamir Secret Sharing (VSSS), hardware FIDO2 passkeys, decentralized multi-clock time anchors, and an isolated AWS Nitro Enclave release signer.

## Core Documentation & Specifications

- [README & Quickstart](https://github.com/Akash1070/Crypto-Inheritance-Platform#readme): Complete setup guide, architecture walkthrough, and local deployment commands.
- [Two-Tier Secret Separation (ADR-0001)](https://github.com/Akash1070/Crypto-Inheritance-Platform/blob/main/docs/adr/ADR-0001-two-tier-secret-separation.md): Web and API tiers never process, accept, or store unencrypted seed phrases or threshold shares.
- [Zero Custom Cryptography (ADR-0002)](https://github.com/Akash1070/Crypto-Inheritance-Platform/blob/main/docs/adr/ADR-0002-no-invented-cryptography.md): Vetted primitives (`libsodium-wrappers-sumo`, `@noble/hashes`, XChaCha20-Poly1305).
- [Passkeys Only Authentication (ADR-0003)](https://github.com/Akash1070/Crypto-Inheritance-Platform/blob/main/docs/adr/ADR-0003-passkeys-only.md): WebAuthn FIDO2 resident keys required for owner and heir authentication. Email is only an alert channel.
- [Isolated Enclave Release (ADR-0004)](https://github.com/Akash1070/Crypto-Inheritance-Platform/blob/main/docs/adr/ADR-0004-isolated-enclave-release.md): Escrow shares decrypted strictly within an isolated AWS Nitro Enclave after 30-day unchallenged claims.
- [Threat Model Runbook](https://github.com/Akash1070/Crypto-Inheritance-Platform/blob/main/docs/THREAT_MODEL_RUNBOOK.md): Threat vectors, APT mitigations, hypervisor attack surfaces, and Sybil resistance.
- [Pre-Launch Security Audit](https://github.com/Akash1070/Crypto-Inheritance-Platform/blob/main/docs/security-audit-unfold-logic-akash-kumar-jha.md): Pre-launch security audit review by Akash Kumar Jha covering P0-P3 vulnerabilities.
- [Dual-License (AGPL-3.0 / Commercial)](https://github.com/Akash1070/Crypto-Inheritance-Platform/blob/main/LICENSE): Open-source copyleft terms and enterprise commercial licensing options.
